title: Apply schema.core.sql with a forward-only migration runner
description: Ship schema.core.sql as migration 0001, a forward-only runner on better-sqlite3 (WAL, foreign_keys ON for every connection, busy_timeout), and run the 54 behaviour tests in CI.
acceptance: A fresh database created by the runner passes tests/schema_core_test.py (54 of 54)
The store port cannot hand out a connection with foreign_keys off (test)
The runner refuses a migration whose file hash differs from the one recorded when it was applied
